DEIMOS Module

Community-driven spambot detection and removal

DEIMOS is a community-driven spambot detection system. Every server member is an Enforcer — no single person can act alone. It takes a group to confirm a kill. Admins and mods bypass the vote entirely — their /deimos kill is an instant confirmed kill.

How It Works

Spot a spambot
→
/deimos kill @user
→
Kill Vote appears
→
2 members confirm
within 300 seconds
→
14-day mute + message purge

Rules

Cannot flag bots, mods, or admins
Admins and mods skip the vote — their kill is instant
Cannot confirm your own kill vote
Only one active vote per target
1-minute cooldown per user between votes
Reversed kills = −1 score for all voters
False positives tracked separately

Scoring

Every confirmed kill earns +1 for everyone who participated — the initiator and all confirmers. If a moderator reverses a kill, everyone who voted receives −1 and a false positive mark.

/deimos killboard

Display the Enforcer leaderboard for your server.

/deimos help

View the full DEIMOS guide from inside Discord.

DEIMOS Network

Permission required: The Ban button in kill reports and /deimos1 ban require HelNet to have Ban Members permission. This is not included in the default invite. Grant it manually under Server Settings → Roles → HelNet if you want ban functionality.

When a moderator clicks the Ban button on a kill report, every other server running DEIMOS with a mod log configured receives a Network Alert. The alert shows the banned user and which server flagged them, with a Preemptive Ban button so other servers can act before the user shows up.

Network alerts only trigger from the Ban button in the mod log — using /deimos1 ban directly does not broadcast.

Moderator Commands

/deimos1 revive @user

Reverse a kill: unmutes the target and marks as a false positive. Scores adjusted for all voters.

Requires: Manage Messages
/deimos1 revive @user mute:<duration>

Reverse a kill and also timeout everyone who voted for it. Duration: 1h–24h or 1d–28d.

Requires: Manage Messages
/deimos1 ban @user [reason]

Ban a user from the server and broadcast a Network Alert to all DEIMOS servers.

Requires: Ban Members
/deimos1 logchannel #channel

Set the channel where kill reports are posted for mod review. Leave empty to clear.

Requires: Administrator
/deimos1 resetkillboard

Reset the server's DEIMOS killboard, wiping all scores and false positive marks.

Requires: Administrator
⚠ Abuse Warning
Do not abuse /deimos kill. Coordinating false votes or flagging real users may result in a mute, ban, or similar infraction. When a kill is reversed, moderators can timeout everyone who voted for it.
